text:
mia_cs: Quick health note for SilverCurrent. Onboarding done but 95p latency ~2.0s and token spend ~1.5x forecast. Renewal in 6 weeks. Thinking proactive perf pilot: int8 quant + small-model hop + routing + KV-cache. ok?

oliver_se: yes. they prioritize snappy UX. suggest small-model for <150 tokens, int8 for mid-length, fp16 for long. low-risk canary.

tara_ml: ran 60-sample eval on customer prompts: redwood-int8-lite median semantic cosine 0.983 vs baseline. Most diffs are formatting/noise, few factual drifts on long contexts. recommend 2% canary + semantic gate.

ben_sre: infra: tenant on shared us-west. KV prefix cache can shave tails; dedicated low-latency route helps but +10% cost. hybrid routing seems best.

mia_cs: proposal: 1) 2% canary for /summarize to int8-lite and small-model for <150 tokens, 2) route >800 tokens -> fp16, 3) KV cache on templates, 4) 48h monitor. rollback if semantic_cosine < 0.975 or 95p_latency > 1.8s.

oliver_se: I'll draft routing snippet and canary rollout. include rand seed and traffic ramp plan.

tara_ml: thresholds: semantic_cosine >= 0.98, 95p_latency decrease >=10% or absolute <1.6s, token_cost_reduction >=20%. I'll prepare quick eval notebook for their seed prompts.

jamie_pm: capture in renewal packet: ROI slide + one-question pulse after pilot: "Was response speed acceptable? (yes / kinda / no)". good for renewal narrative.

ben_sre: ops checklist: provision canary nodes, toggle KV cache, dashboard tiles for cache hit rate and token delta, alerts for semantic_cosine < 0.975 (20m) and 95p_latency > 1800ms (15m).

ops-bot: alert created: channel=#cs-silvercurrent-alerts, semantic_cosine < 0.975 (20m), 95p_latency > 1800ms (15m). owner: ben_sre.

mia_cs: timeline: start canary Mon 09:00 PT, monitor 48h, quick sync Tue EOD, ramp Wed if green. I'll message the account and book enablement. thanks team :thumbsup:
